caption: The drawing depicts a metallic teapot with a wide base that tapers toward the top, a curved spout on the left, and a large, curved handle on the right. The body, spout, handle, and lid of the teapot are dark, almost black, in color. The surface of the teapot features decorative patterns including large red and orange rose-like flowers with green leaves, arranged vertically and grouped in clusters on the central body and along the bottom rim. The lid is dome-shaped with a rounded knob and is decorated with similar green leafy designs. Near the lower right edge of the image, the name "Franklin Sipes" is inscribed in small, reddish letters. The background is plain, off-white, with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Toleware Teapot
